term.sae.title: Sparse Autoencoder (SAE)
term.sae.summary: An autoencoder that encodes model activations into sparse features and reconstructs them, enabling feature-level analysis.
term.sae.description: An autoencoder that encodes model activations into sparse features and reconstructs them, enabling feature-level analysis.
term.sae.why_it_matters: Feature descriptions are meaningful only when model, activation site, and SAE checkpoint identities are fixed.

term.sae.reproducible.title: Reproducible SAE experiments
term.sae.reproducible.summary: A provenance protocol recording the model, SAE, input, activation site, and intervention settings for each experiment.
term.sae.reproducible.description: A provenance protocol recording the model, SAE, input, activation site, and intervention settings for each experiment.
term.sae.reproducible.why_it_matters: Recorded input and checkpoint identities make intervention outcomes comparable across runs.

term.sae.assets.title: Model and prompt artifact identity
term.sae.assets.summary: The model adapter, SAE profile, prompt data files, and their verified origins used in a research run.
term.sae.assets.description: The model adapter, SAE profile, prompt data files, and their verified origins used in a research run.
term.sae.assets.why_it_matters: Identifying the exact model, SAE weights, and prompt artifacts is necessary for defensible experimental comparisons.

term.sae.capture.title: SAE feature capture
term.sae.capture.summary: Read tensors from a specified model activation site and encode them into SAE feature activations.
term.sae.capture.description: Read tensors from a specified model activation site and encode them into SAE feature activations.
term.sae.capture.why_it_matters: Captured feature activations are the measurement input to interventions and interpretation experiments.

term.sae.intervene.title: Teacher-forced feature intervention
term.sae.intervene.summary: Edit features or model activations under a fixed input sequence and activation site, then compare the resulting outputs.
term.sae.intervene.description: Edit features or model activations under a fixed input sequence and activation site, then compare the resulting outputs.
term.sae.intervene.why_it_matters: Holding input conditions constant makes changes in model output attributable to the specified edit.

term.sae.generate.title: SAE intervention during generation
term.sae.generate.summary: Apply selected feature edits as the model generates successive tokens and compare the continuation with the baseline.
term.sae.generate.description: Apply selected feature edits as the model generates successive tokens and compare the continuation with the baseline.
term.sae.generate.why_it_matters: The method extends fixed-input interventions to stateful autoregressive generation trajectories.

term.sae.circuits.title: SAE causal circuit analysis
term.sae.circuits.summary: Trace candidate paths among model components and feature interventions; causal interpretations require independent tests.
term.sae.circuits.description: Trace candidate paths among model components and feature interventions; causal interpretations require independent tests.
term.sae.circuits.why_it_matters: A proposed circuit requires interventions and corroborating evidence before assigning causal roles.

term.sae.explain.title: Automatic SAE feature explanation
term.sae.explain.summary: Propose semantic hypotheses for features and evaluate their predictions on separate examples.
term.sae.explain.description: Propose semantic hypotheses for features and evaluate their predictions on separate examples.
term.sae.explain.why_it_matters: Feature meaning depends on context; explanations should be evaluated on independent examples.

term.sae.benchmark.title: SAE benchmarking and reliability

term.sae.benchmark.description: Evaluate reconstruction, interventions, controlled comparisons, and reliability through a common benchmark runner.
term.sae.benchmark.why_it_matters: A traceable evaluation protocol permits fair comparison across SAEs and experimental conditions.

term.sae.sar_rss.title: SAR and RSS benchmark adapters
term.sae.sar_rss.summary: Integrate behavioral compositionality and response-sensitivity evaluations into the SAE benchmark interface.
term.sae.sar_rss.description: Integrate behavioral compositionality and response-sensitivity evaluations into the SAE benchmark interface.
term.sae.sar_rss.why_it_matters: Preserving sampling, controls, and original measurements is essential for faithful SAR and RSS evaluation.

term.sae.train.description: Optimize sparse autoencoder parameters with a registered training task and its native training backend.
